marks.gloss_en: שכן אורגי יריעות זורקין בוכיאר לשואליהן -- a Tabernacle practice of throwing
והא במקום פטור קאזלא! -- but it travels in an exempt place
ודילמא גבי הדדי הוו יתבי?! -- perhaps they sat beside each other
מטו הדדי בחפת -- they would reach each other with the chefet
rather: for the weavers of the curtains threw the shuttle to those who borrowed it from them
כל ארבע אמות ברשות הרבים גמרא גמירי לה -- a received tradition (no support kind names one; svara under protest)
ותו: מעביר ארבע אמות ברשות הרבים מנלן דמחייב? -- and further: carrying [not throwing] four cubits -- whence? [the derivation does not reach it]
rather: all of [the law of] four cubits in the public domain is a received tradition
והלא אוגדו בידו! -- but he holds [the thread of the shuttle] in his hand
בניסכא בתרא -- with the last thread
Rav Chisda: for the weavers of the curtains threw the shuttle in the curtain
ודילמא שלחופי הוו משלחפי?! -- perhaps they were staggered -- unanswered
ותו, מי שאילי מהדדי? והתני לודא: ממלאכתו הוא עושה ואינו עושה ממלאכת חבירו -- did they borrow from one another at all?
Luda's baraita: 'each man from his work that they were doing' (Ex 36:4) -- he works from his own work and does not work from his fellow's work
and one who throws four cubits onto the ground is liable
'and they passed (ויעבירו) a proclamation in the camp' (Ex 36:6) / 'and you shall pass (והעברת) a shofar blast' (Lev 25:9, on Yom Kippur): as there the passing is on a prohibited day, so here
וממאי דבשבת קאי? דילמא בחול קאי -- how do we know he stood [commanding] on Shabbat? perhaps on a weekday, because the work was complete
גמר העברה העברה מיום הכפורים (= gs_haavara_haavara, p_haavara_beyom_asur)
perhaps he stood [commanding] on a weekday, because the work was complete, as it is written 'and the work was sufficient' (Ex 36:7)
סברא היא: מכדי מרשות לרשות הוא, מה לי אפוקי ומה לי עיולי
after all, it is from domain to domain -- what difference is it to me whether carrying out or carrying in?
Moses sat in the Levites' camp, the public domain, and told Israel not to carry out from their private domain to it
after all, throwing is a tolda of carrying-out
שכן תופרי יריעות זורקין מחטיהן זה לזה -- a Tabernacle practice of throwing
אורגין, מחטין למה להו? -- weavers, what do they need needles for?

ודילמא גבי הדדי הוו יתבי?! -- perhaps they sat beside each other [and handed, not threw]
מטו הדדי במחטין -- they would reach each other with the needles
דילמא בתוך ארבע הוו יתבי? -- perhaps they sat within four [cubits of each other] -- unanswered; the stam turns to Rav Chisda (אלא)
as there [the shofar of Yom Kippur] the passing is on a prohibited day, so here the passing is on a prohibited day
if he did two avot together, or two toldot together, he is liable twice
R' Eliezer, who holds one liable for a tolda in the place of an av
מר סבר הא מיהת לא מספקא -- carrying, at least, is not the doubtful labor
detaching, at least, is not the doubtful labor
gathering, at least, is not the doubtful labor
it is obvious to Rav Yehuda that one who carries [four cubits] is liable: this one at least is not in doubt
אחת ותו לא? והתנן: אבות מלאכות ארבעים חסר אחת, והוינן בה: מנינא למה לי? ואמר רבי יוחנן: שאם עשאן כולם בהעלם אחת חייב על כל אחת ואחת
what is the practical difference? for Rav's [teaching from the scroll]

say: he is not liable for one of them
the wood-gatherer was one who carried four cubits in the public domain
'in the desert' (Num 15:32, the wood-gatherer) / 'in the desert' (Num 27:3, 'our father died in the desert'): as there it is Zelophehad, so here it is Zelophehad
the wood-gatherer (Num 15:32) is Zelophehad
R' Yehuda ben Beteira: Akiva, either way you will be judged -- if as you say, the Torah concealed him and you reveal him; if not, you cast slander on that righteous man
